purpose: Benchmark reference labels: blind labels for the eval split, by Claude Sonnet 5.5 subagents (5 clips each, generators mixed per task). Each saw only caption, rubric (7 PC items incl. the universal fatal item) and video frames. sa_score / pc_score computed with teacher/scoring.py.

clips.caption: A large temple bell is struck once with its wooden beam, and a small pebble resting on the bell's shoulder skitters and slides off.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: The pebble appears and moves within a few frames, so its origin is hard to judge.
clips.clip_summary: A silver bell on a wooden stand, no pebble on its shoulder at the start. A hand holding a wooden beam touches the bell top around 0-1s, 2.7-3.0s and 3.5s, and again swings in at 4.2s and 5s, so several contacts. At 3.62s a white pebble appears at the beam tip, flies left in the air (3.79s) and drops out the bottom-left of view. A dark smudge appears on the bell shoulder at 3.67-3.71s.

uncovered.what: Dark smudge/hand-shaped shadow appears on the bell shoulder

items.check: Rainbow bands slide across the wall as it turns.

items.evidence: Disc is highly reflective with rainbow sheen.
items.check: The disc is shiny.

items.evidence: No bands on the wall, so nothing slides with the tilt.
items.check: The tilt comes first and the bands slide with it.

items.evidence: No bands on wall to judge.
items.expect: The bands move as the disc tilts and only then.
items.fail: They slide with the disc still; or stay put while the disc turns; or flicker in steady sun.

items.evidence: Disc is in sun yet no bands appear on the wall.
items.expect: The bands appear only while the sun hits the disc and would vanish when the disc is turned away or the sun covered.
items.fail: They are there with no sun; or the disc is in sun with no bands; or they remain with the disc turned away.
items.matched_fail: the disc is in sun with no bands

items.evidence: No bands on the wall.
items.expect: The bands are rainbow-coloured and the wall stays white.
items.fail: They are a single colour; or white; or the wall changes colour.

items.evidence: No bands on the wall.
items.expect: The bands are curved streaks.
items.fail: They are a single round spot; or sharp squares; or flood the wall.

items.evidence: One disc throughout.
items.expect: One disc.
items.fail: It duplicates; or vanishes; or a band becomes solid.

items.evidence: From 3.3s the ribbon pile swells into a larger tangled mass of new coloured ribbons with no visible cause.
items.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
items.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.
items.matched_fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or ... duplicates

items.evidence: Room and wall unchanged, disc keeps shape.
items.expect: The room stays the same.
items.fail: The room rearranges; or the wall changes; or the disc changes shape.

clips.caption: A red sock is dropped into a basin of hot soapy water holding white shirts, and the water around it turns pink.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: Whether the sock counts as dropped versus held and pushed is a judgement call.
clips.clip_summary: A white shirt lies in a soapy basin. From 0.7s a red sock is lowered into the basin by an unseen hand and pressed onto the shirts (1.2-4.0s). Pink coloured water appears around it from ~2.7s and spreads over the water to 5.0s; the sock is withdrawn at the right edge near the end.

items.evidence: White shirts lie in a beige basin with soap bubbles at 0.0s.
items.check: A basin of water holds white shirts.

items.evidence: The red sock is lowered by an invisible hand from 0.7s and stays held and pressed onto the shirts (1.2-4.0s), then withdrawn at the right by 4.7s; it is never dropped and released.
items.check: A red sock is dropped in.

items.evidence: Pink water is visible around the sock from about 2.7s and spreads over the water surface by 3.3-5.0s.
items.check: The water around it turns pink.

items.evidence: Soap bubbles/foam on the water surface; water looks soapy (heat not visible).
items.check: The water is hot and soapy.

items.evidence: Sock enters at about 1.0-1.5s and pink appears only afterwards (~2.7s).
items.check: The sock goes in first and the pink spreads after.

items.evidence: Pink starts near the sock and spreads wider through the water through 5.0s without clearing.
items.expect: The pink spreads out from the sock through the water and does not clear again.
items.fail: The water clears again; or is pink before the sock; or the pink retreats to the sock.

items.evidence: Sock remains red; water is pink; shirts only tinged.
items.expect: The water is pink and the sock stays red; the nearest shirts take a faint tinge.
items.fail: The sock turns white; or the water turns a colour other than pink; or far shirts turn deep red at once.

items.evidence: Water behaves as liquid with the pink diffusing and bubbles.
items.expect: The water is liquid and the dye drifts in it.
items.fail: The water is rigid; or the dye is a solid lump; or beads bounce.

items.evidence: The sock is pushed down into the water among the shirts 1.5-4.0s; it is held, not floating.
items.expect: The sock sinks or settles among the shirts.
items.fail: It floats above the water; or rises out; or hangs.

items.evidence: One sock, shirts keep their number.
items.expect: One sock and the shirts keep their number.
items.fail: A second sock appears; or a shirt vanishes; or the sock passes through the basin.

items.evidence: Nothing appears, vanishes or passes through another object.
items.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
items.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

items.evidence: Basin and room unchanged apart from camera motion.
items.expect: The basin and the room stay the same.
items.fail: The basin changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the shirts change shape.
